_meta.description: Per-file provenance vs HestiaCP. source_type 'eigenbau' = HestiaRE-native (or origin not auto-confirmable - see note). Recompute is a manual, occasional job; numbers are a snapshot at upstream_ref + measured_at, not live.
_meta.divergence_method: churn = (added+removed)/(upstream_lines+our_lines)*100 from `git diff --numstat`. RAW - overstates semantic divergence. Triage, not truth.

source_type_values.cherry-pick: Isolated upstream bugfix taken directly. Manual promotion.
source_type_values.eigenbau: HestiaRE-native OR origin not auto-confirmable (see note).

_meta.third_party_note: Third-party vendored code is tracked in VENDORED.json, not here; those paths are excluded to keep the two manifests disjoint.
_meta.reorg_note: #119 dissolved upstream install/deb/ into share/; paths do not line up 1:1. Matches are exact-path first, then unique basename; unmatched files are marked eigenbau with a note and need manual origin confirmation. Best-effort, not authoritative.
